_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: hot/sunny/summer ↔ cold/snow/frozen
axes.rationale: All three lenses agree: the positive end gives snow, frost, frozen, freezing and ski, and the negative end gives sun, sunshine, sunny, hot, July and tropical; the real-logit correlation shows only function words.

axes.label: extreme heat/hotter ↔ snow/winter in contrast framing
axes.rationale: The Jacobian, logit and tuned lenses put hotter, hot, Heat and overhe on the negative end, and snow, 雪, winter, contrast, compared and instead on the positive end; this suggests a comparative-cold reading against intensified heat.

axes.label: temperature vocabulary ↔ exclamatory punctuation
axes.rationale: Only the Jacobian lens is clear: the negative end has thermometer, temperature, colder and hottest, and the positive end has variants of '!' with newlines; the logit and tuned lenses give subword fragments.
